pages.text: A Slaughtergleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a red-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an asscher cut.$(br2)When held, your attacks are considered to have one level of the Looting enchantment. If you are wielding a weapon with the Looting enchantment, its level is increased by one instead.
Slaughtergleams can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
